title: Shem's descendants: 26 names (Eber to Jobab), messianic line marked
summary: Numbered list of Shem's descendants from 1 to 26: his sons (Eber, Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram), then Aram's sons, Arpachshad to Shelah to Eber, Eber's sons Peleg and Joktan, and Joktan's thirteen sons. Small star-of-David symbols mark Eber, Arpachshad, Shelah and Peleg, and an asterisk follows Shem. Joktan's list sits in a separate block on the right.
